hadith:
Virtues of the Night of Qadr - Narrated Ibn `Abbas:

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Look for the Night of Qadr in the last ten nights of Ramadan ,' on the night when nine or seven or five nights remain out of the last ten nights of Ramadan (i.e. 21, 23, 25, respectively).
message: Allah knows what is in your heart and can grant serenity amid uncertainty, as He did for the believers beneath the tree. Seek the Night of Qadr in the last ten nights of Ramadan, and remember that Al-Muhsi, the All-Enumerating, knows and counts all things.
name:
Al Muhsi - الْمُحْصِي - The All-Enumerating

Al Muhsi expresses Allah's complete enumeration and knowledge of all things. Quran 72:28 and 78:29 describe His counting and recording through verbs. The relevant root is ح ص ي, as in أحصى, rather than ح ص ر.
verse:
Al-Fath - The Victory - 48:18-19

Indeed, Allah was pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you ˹O Prophet˺ under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down serenity upon them and rewarded them with a victory at hand, and many spoils of war they will gain. For Allah is Almighty, All-Wise.
